verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS coding agent, but the evidence pack documents no export feature for sessions, knowledge, playbooks, or other account data in open formats. The API and MCP server give programmatic access to session management and knowledge, but they are developer building blocks rather than an export capability. AGENTS.md support covers reading context into Devin, not taking data out, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
